sql: UPDATE action_sources SET enabled = false, notes = COALESCE(notes, '') || ' [706] Disabled: use PUT customer_referral_first_booking on completed.', updated_at = NOW() WHERE method = 'POST' AND action_name = 'customer_referral_first_booking' AND (route_pattern LIKE '%/bookings/create%' OR route_pattern LIKE '%/customer/bookings/create%')
